_doc: MapGen tile tables. ushort tile IDs (decimal or 0xHEX). Single source of truth, loaded by TileTables.Default / TileTables.LoadDefault() (CLI, editor, web). TileTables.BuildDefault() is an identical built-in copy for checkouts without this file. Beach: WALKABLE sand is ONLY 0x16-0x19 (22-25) — the 4 soft-sand variants. 0x1A-0x1C (26-28) are sloped-sand variants flagged Impassable in tiledata (used for cliff/dune slope edges, never as a beach fill). 0x64 (100) is a decorative impassable scatter tile. Wet-sand rim (0x75-0x78) belongs in a separate water-edge transition pass, not in this fill pool. Distribution is uniform — earlier 0x19 x8 weighting produced visible diamond banding when CoastSmoothPass.BrushCoherence painted NxN coherent blocks.
_doc_land: Interior (plain) land tile per biome. Verified against real Britannia (tiledata names + frequency): forest floor 0xC4-0xC7 evenly, jungle floor 0xAC-0xAF, mountain interior 0x22C-0x22F 'rock'. 0xC8-0xCB are forest/grass blend tiles and 0xDC-0xDF cliff faces; neither is an interior fill. TileTables.BuildDefault() mirrors this file exactly (asserted by TileTablesTests).
_doc_forest_species: Leafy/summer tree IDs. 0x0CCA-0x0CCC are dead/winter and only used for tundra+snow. Oak/cedar/palm dominant elsewhere.
